messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: elevated 504s detected on edge (eu-west-1) for API paths /v1/generate and /v1/embeds. spike started ~04:12 UTC. 504 rate ≈8x baseline. paging on-call. dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/edge-pulse/504s

Ava (oncall): I'm on it — checking ingress logs and current routing. can anyone confirm which upstream is timing out?

Priya (sre): quick summary from traces: origin is ingress-proxy -> connection timeouts to runtime-pool-b (g4dn-type nodes). 95p backend latency up from 90ms -> 1.2s. seeing TCP FIN/RSTs from a subset of nodes. impacted customers: ~10 tenants; largest is NoteAI (~15% failed requests last 10m). attaching a sample tail from proxy logs.

Sam (infra): I'm going to enable conservative knockback on eu-west edge for non-enterprise customers to reduce fanout. plan: lower concurrency and enable per-route circuit breaker for 30m. command to patch proxy config:

```
# set per-route max_inflight and knockback window
kubectl -n ingress patch configmap edge-proxy-config --patch '{"data":{"max_inflight":"200","knockback_window_ms":"250"}}'
```

Sam (infra): applying now. will monitor metrics.

Diego (runtime): fyi from runtime side: we see KV cache thrash for the new quantized m90 variant on pool-b, causing large tail latencies under burst. clients hitting new model variant -> backend slow -> proxy times out. recommended immediate mitigation: fallback those routes to m90-int8-reduced variant or raise backend connect+read timeout to 8s while we stabilize. can call rollout API:

```
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/rollouts" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"service":"runtime","rule":"/v1/generate","variant":"m90-int8-reduced","percent":100}'
```

Marta (support): I'm prepping a customer note + status page. which approach are we taking? customers asking for workaround in the meantime.

Ava (oncall): Going to do two things in parallel: 1) trigger 20% traffic reroute to us-east for non-prem traffic (quick relief), 2) coordinate with Diego to trigger model-variant fallback on pool-b. Sam, confirm the knockback applied?

Sam (infra): knockback patch applied. I've routed 20% of eu-west traffic to us-east using routing policy. initial metrics look better. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: status update @channel: 504 rate down ~60% since reroute and knockback. still above baseline but stabilizing. next automated check in 5m.

Priya (sre): I rolled a conservative kernel parameter tweak on 3 nodes in runtime-pool-b (canary). tail latencies on those canaries dropped ~40%. logs still show occasional upstream connection resets — investigating whether it's a NIC-level issue vs runtime threads.

Diego (runtime): initiating model-variant fallback now for pool-b. will watch memory and latency. fallback command returned 202, rollout progressing.

Marta (support): status page updated and CS notified for affected tenants. sent NoteAI a targeted message and opened a follow-up ticket.

Ava (oncall): handoff note for night: leaving monitoring on, handoff to Sam (night) at 1768736800 with runbook link https://redwood.internal/runbooks/edge-504-knockback. summary: knockback+reroute+variant-fallback applied, 504s -60% and trending down. if rate creeps up, escalate to runtime-eng.

Sam (infra): acked. I'll watch overnight and escalate if we see >5% error rate sustained for 15m. leaving tcpdump and packet capture on nodes for first 2hrs.

Marta (support): support queue updated. customers informed. will sync with CS first thing.

Ava (oncall): switching to monitoring-only. will close once stable for 30m. thanks all. :pray:
